required_outcomes: Accepts Alder Compliance's decline at event 013 and takes them off the job.

Gets a locksmith sourced for the same scope (replace the conservatory back-door lock, four keys with two for the tenants and the landlord's and agency's keys to the office): assigns a locksmith if one is on file, otherwise returns the job to provider selection.
Tells the tenant (Clara Jenkins) that Alder Compliance will not be attending after all and a locksmith is being arranged, without inventing a firm or date.
acceptable_alternatives: Returning the ticket to auto mode for provider selection with a note that the job needs a locksmith, not a compliance contractor.
Briefly letting Quinn know the contractor has changed, without asking him to approve again.
Replying to Alder with a short thanks confirming they are released from the job.
positive_behaviours: Notes on the record that Alder Compliance does not do lock work, so it is not picked again for locks.
Sets a follow-up for the new provider's booking.
Asks the tenant whether the door can still be locked meanwhile.
red_flags: Asking the landlord to approve the work again because the contractor changed.
Escalating a routine reassignment to a human.
prohibited_actions: Leaving Alder Compliance assigned or chasing them to book after they declined.
Telling the tenant a named locksmith or a date is booked when no tool confirms it.
critical_failures: Ending the turn with no replacement provider sought (no assignment and no return to provider selection), so the job sits with a contractor that has declined it.
